description: This file defines a custom 'attachment' node for a rich text editor using the Tiptap framework, including its attributes, rendering, commands, and keyboard shortcuts. It is part of the Notesnook project and manages attachment-related functionalities such as inserting, removing, and updating attachments within the editor.

classes.name: AttachmentNode
classes.description: A custom Tiptap node representing an attachment, with attributes for type, progress, hash, filename, mime, and size, and methods for rendering, command execution, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: getDataAttribute
methods.description: Utility function to generate HTML attribute handlers for data attributes such as hash, filename, mime, and size.
